description: Coupled Julia AMD profiles: explicit carry-axis exploratory cases and matched materialized/carry × exact-zero support variants. All physical cross-variant arrays exact.

stage.note: New isolated copy; originals unchanged. Profiler helper/runner copied separately.

runtime.device: HIPDevice(id=1, name=AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT, gcn_arch=gfx1030)

summary.caveat: Intrusive event intervals include event-record/driver gaps. Compare with an uninstrumented matched batch; do not treat them as isolated instruction time.

caveats: Intrusive event recording changes host/stream gaps; compare measured overhead before attributing small stages.
Mixed sense/regulate kernels include physical cues/plasticity as well as support loops.
These short settled512-founder states do not establish dense-contact scaling.
256cubed full detached parity was deliberately omitted under the8GiB host cap.
